systems.system: National Public Sector Reform Strategy II (NPSRS II)
systems.country_label: National Public Sector Reform Strategy II
systems.owner: Ministry of State for Public Sector Reforms
systems.tiers: proposed five-year strategy with seven pillars, 27 programmes and 135 activities; draft validated at a stakeholder workshop in July 2026 before submission to the Chief of Staff, Cabinet and Parliament; includes expanding digital government services and a monitoring and evaluation framework

note: Public sector reform strategy covers the state's own services, so class government; no national digital strategy instrument.
